map.体对角线穿越立方体内部连接对顶点（d=a√3），普通面对角线在平面内（a√2）；: The space diagonal passes through the interior of the cube connecting opposite vertices (d=a√3), while a face diagonal stays in the plane (a√2); the largest straight dimension for packing is the space diagonal, and transport height and width limits must be checked against it.
